page.overview:
Who is Anaiya Carel?

Anaiya Carel (pronounced: ah-NYE-yah) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Anaiya Carel|Anaiya}} Evidence suggests that she was at one time the Blue Ajah First Selector.

Anaiya stood about 5'6" tall and was dark haired with a homely 'blunt face'. She had a warm smile. According to Moiraine, "almost everyone felt comforted, safe and special, when Anaiya smiled at them". Anaiya enjoyed beautiful clothing and had a fondness for wearing lace and ruffles.

She was astute politically and a first-rate organizer. Likely this was one of the reasons she was included among the Salidar Six. Moiraine calls her open, honest, and "accepting of everyone" while still able to see into the heart of the matter. She was not a flighty woman. Instead, she was deliberate, unflappable, and careful with her words.

She is kind towards children. When in Fal Dara, she ruffles the heads of playing boys as she passes. She is less formal than many Aes Sedai in other ways, asking Amalisa Jagad to call her by her first name only, while asking permission to call her merely "Amalisa". Egwene thinks that she is "different from the others, more like a woman from home".
